tagline: All your digital needs under one roof!!!
mission: To put every digital capability a business needs — software, design, marketing and AI automation — under one roof, so our clients can build, launch and grow without juggling multiple vendors.
vision: To become the most trusted digital studio for ambitious companies, where world-class engineering and AI-driven automation turn ideas into measurable growth.

values.name: Trust

values.name: Innovation
values.description: We adopt AI and modern technology early to give our clients a competitive edge.

values.name: Simplicity
values.description: We remove complexity so clients experience one team, one process and one point of accountability.

companyStory: HN9 Codecraft started as a small team of engineers and designers who were tired of watching businesses stitch together freelancers and agencies to get a single product live. We built HN9 to be the opposite: one accountable studio that handles development, design, SEO, and AI automation end to end. Today HN9 AI Studio blends senior engineering talent with an AI-first workflow, helping startups, small businesses, mid-size companies and enterprises ship faster and grow with confidence — all under one roof.

AI automation embedded into every engagement
Senior talent with premium delivery standards
Outcome and growth focused, not just deliverables
